left.pt-BR: Nuna acorda bem cedinho. O sol ja vem!
left.en: Nuna wakes up early. The sun is coming!
left.es-MX: Nuna se despierta temprano. ¡El sol ya viene!

right.pt-BR: O galo tambem acorda. Canta bem forte!
right.en: The rooster wakes too. Sings very loud!
right.es-MX: El gallo también se despierta. ¡Canta muy fuerte!

spreads.scene: A young girl stretches her arms to the sky, yawning. A rooster stretches its neck to the sky, crowing. Both are in a farmyard with a fence in the middle ground and a rising sun in the sky.

left.pt-BR: Nuna vai para o celeiro. O dia comecou!
left.en: Nuna goes to the barn. The day has begun!
left.es-MX: Nuna va al granero. ¡El día ha comenzado!

right.pt-BR: A galinha corre. Quer seu milho logo!
right.en: The hen runs. Wants her corn soon!
right.es-MX: La gallina corre. ¡Quiere su maíz pronto!

spreads.scene: A young girl walks towards a barn, looking excited. A hen runs towards a feed trough, looking eager. Both are in a farmyard with a barn in the background and a clear sky.

left.pt-BR: Nuna joga milho. As galinhas comem!
left.en: Nuna throws corn. The hens eat!

right.pt-BR: O porco come milho. Faz um barulho!
right.en: The pig eats corn. Makes a big noise!
right.es-MX: El cerdo come maíz. ¡Hace un ruido!

spreads.scene: A young girl scatters corn on the ground with an open hand. A pig eats corn from the ground with its snout. Both are in a farmyard with a wooden fence in the middle ground and a clear sky.

left.pt-BR: Nuna bebe agua. Que sede, ai que bom!
left.en: Nuna drinks water. So thirsty, so good!
left.es-MX: Nuna bebe agua. ¡Qué sed, qué rico!

right.pt-BR: O cavalo bebe agua. Faz um pocinho!
right.en: The horse drinks water. Makes a small puddle!
right.es-MX: El caballo bebe agua. ¡Hace un charquito!

spreads.scene: A young girl drinks water from a cup. A horse drinks water from a trough. Both are in a farmyard with a water pump in the background and a clear sky.

left.pt-BR: Nuna acaricia o cavalo. Ele e manso.
left.en: Nuna pets the horse. He is gentle.
left.es-MX: Nuna acaricia al caballo. Él es manso.

right.pt-BR: O cavalo cheira a Nuna. Ele e carinhoso.
right.en: The horse sniffs Nuna. He is affectionate.
right.es-MX: El caballo huele a Nuna. Él es cariñoso.

spreads.scene: A young girl gently pats the side of a horse's head. A horse nuzzles its head against the girl's hand. Both are in a stable with hay on the ground and wooden walls.

left.pt-BR: Nuna ajuda a mamae. Vamos tirar o leite!
left.en: Nuna helps mommy. Let's milk the cow!
left.es-MX: Nuna ayuda a mamá. ¡Vamos a ordeñar!

right.pt-BR: A vaca esta quietinha. Gosta de carinho.
right.en: The cow is still. Likes to be petted.
right.es-MX: La vaca está quietita. Le gusta el cariño.

spreads.scene: A young girl stands next to an adult, holding a small pail. A cow stands calmly as if being milked. Both are in a milking parlor with hay on the ground and wooden walls.

left.pt-BR: Nuna carrega o balde. Que pesado!
left.en: Nuna carries the pail. So heavy!

right.pt-BR: A vaca come capim. Que saboroso!
right.en: The cow eats grass. So tasty!

spreads.scene: A young girl walks carefully, carrying a small, full pail with both hands. A cow eats grass from the ground with its head down. Both are in a grassy field with a fence in the background and a blue sky.

left.pt-BR: Nuna se senta na cerca. Olhando o mundo.
left.en: Nuna sits on the fence. Watching the world.
left.es-MX: Nuna se sienta en la cerca. Mirando el mundo.

right.pt-BR: O porco se espreguica. Depois vai dormir.
right.en: The pig stretches out. Then goes to sleep.
right.es-MX: El cerdo se estira. Luego va a dormir.

spreads.scene: A young girl sits on a wooden fence, looking out at the farm. A pig lies down in the mud, stretching its legs. Both are in a farmyard with a fence in the middle ground and a clear sky.

left.pt-BR: Nuna corre no campo. Que vento bom!
left.en: Nuna runs in the field. What a nice wind!
left.es-MX: Nuna corre en el campo. ¡Qué buen viento!

right.pt-BR: O cavalo corre livre. Que alegria!
right.en: The horse runs free. What joy!

spreads.scene: A young girl runs with arms outstretched in a wide-open field. A horse gallops freely across the field with its mane flowing. Both are in a large green field with a distant tree line and a blue sky.

left.pt-BR: Nuna brinca na terra. Faz um buraco.
left.en: Nuna plays in the dirt. Makes a hole.
left.es-MX: Nuna juega en la tierra. Hace un agujero.

right.pt-BR: A galinha ciscando. Procura um bichinho.
right.en: The hen scratches. Looks for a bug.
right.es-MX: La gallina escarba. Busca un bichito.

spreads.scene: A young girl kneels on the ground, digging in the dirt with her hands. A hen scratches at the dirt with its claws. Both are in a farmyard with loose earth on the ground and a wooden fence in the background.

left.pt-BR: Nuna esfrega as maos. Que sujeira!
left.en: Nuna rubs her hands. So dirty!
left.es-MX: Nuna se frota las manos. ¡Qué suciedad!

right.pt-BR: O porco no lamaçal. Adora a lama!
right.en: The pig in the mud. Loves the mud!
right.es-MX: El cerdo en el lodazal. ¡Le encanta el lodo!

spreads.scene: A young girl rubs her dirty hands together with a playful grimace. A pig rolls around happily in a muddy puddle. Both are in a farmyard with a muddy patch on the ground and a wooden fence.

left.pt-BR: Nuna dorme feliz. Sonha com a fazenda.
left.en: Nuna sleeps happily. Dreams of the farm.
left.es-MX: Nuna duerme feliz. Sueña con la granja.

right.pt-BR: O galo dorme no poleiro. Amanha tem mais!
right.en: The rooster sleeps on its perch. More tomorrow!
right.es-MX: El gallo duerme en el gallinero. ¡Mañana hay más!

spreads.scene: A young girl sleeps soundly in her bed, smiling gently. A rooster sleeps on a wooden perch, head tucked under its wing. Both are in a cozy bedroom/barn interior with a window showing the night sky.
